# Tomás Durães

> Personal portfolio of Tomás Durães, a backend developer and technology enthusiast.

## About

Tomás Durães is a student and backend developer interested in programming, Linux, macOS, and computer systems.

## Projects

- [NixOS Configuration](https://github.com/quicktommy/nixos-config): Personal NixOS configuration with a customized Linux environment using Hyprland.
- [Hackintosh Tahoe EFI](https://github.com/quicktommy/IdeaPad-Gaming-3-15ARH05-Hackintosh): Hackintosh EFI configuration and experiments with running macOS on non-Apple hardware using OpenCore.

## Skills

NixOS, Hyprland, Zsh, OpenCore, EFI, macOS, Git, and GitHub.
